text.insert: Run development commands from the Prompt Kit repository root after installing the Core workspace dependencies. The library can be used without the internal agent host or MCP service.

bun install
bun run test
bun run typecheck

Individual package checks use bun run --cwd packages/<package> test or typecheck. The agent test command includes both test/ and catalog/. Preserve the current consumer Tailwind paths and React deduplication settings when changing the UI package.

The headless authoring entry is @codecaine-ai/prompt-kit/authoring. React consumers use the UI subpath matching their surface. Hosts supply Tailwind layers and semantic token variables; the library does not impose an application shell.

The host listens on http://127.0.0.1:4850 and keeps trace.db, kernel.json, edit sessions, and transcripts under packages/prompt-kit-agent/.agent-kernel. PROMPT_KIT_KERNEL_PORT overrides the port; PROMPT_KIT_KERNEL_PROMPT_EDITOR_MODEL overrides the model alias; PROMPT_KIT_KERNEL_PI_AGENT_DIR selects model configuration instead of the package .pi-agent directory.
The internal host mounts only its catalog and intentionally supports editing prompt-editor itself. Health is at /health; catalog, annotations, edit sessions, and trace reads use /kernel.

Start Observatory from the Core workspace and select Projects → Prompt Kit → Agents for prompt inspection or Traces for recorded runs. Canvas also hosts the Prompt Lab on its /config surface. Viewers consume the same canonical prompt and render; their unsaved editor state remains local.

bun run mcp:doctor
bun scripts/verify-installed-mcp.ts
bun scripts/verify-installed-mcp.ts --claude
These checks use disposable mutation fixtures and read the actual catalog. Restart clients after installation; protocol tests do not refresh a currently open client tool list.
